pieces.Text: Insects, spiders, grubs, and other vermin plague you constantly. They crawl in your hair, fill your clothes, and fly or crawl into your mouth, nose, and ears. You take a -4 penalty on Diplomacy checks, and when you first meet someone, the person's initial attitude toward you starts one level lower than normal. Animals shy away from you-you take a -4 penalty on Handle Animal checks. You gain a +
bonus on Fortitude saves versus poisons from insects, scorpions, and spiders, as well as the distraction ability of swarms of such creatures.
You gain DR 10/- against all swarm damage.
You become immune to the swarm damage and the distraction ability of insect, scorpion, and spider swarms.
